identity: hairline rules and small diamond points

references.finding: Left black headline over soft diffuse daylight; long thin rules with small star points.
Centered directory above transparent rounded outline entry panels.
Centered number above chapter title and flanking fine rules.
Portrait on left, fine outlined content fields on right, leaf-shadow ground.
Repeats centered chapter grammar; shared chapters intentionally allowed.
Circular still life opposite original numbered prose; avoid tiny baked book lettering.
Open type columns and thin rules over soft shadow; no invented chart values.
Short left closing title, fine horizontal lines and diffuse gray daylight.

Only same-role chapters exempt.
limitations: Isolated actual HTTP export only; not deployment acceptance.
